**C. phosphocreatine stores.** For very high force contractions lasting 1–2 seconds, the small stock of ATP already in the muscle is used first, but it is depleted almost immediately. Phosphocreatine then regenerates ATP rapidly, so it is the main initial energy source. Some textbooks treat the ATP store as the very first source, which is why D is a possible alternative.

CONFIDENCE: 60
